save_sentence_transformer_model: save a sentence transformer model and tokenizer to an output path with safe serialization
tokenize_texts_for_embedding: tokenize a list of strings or text pairs into token ids for sentence transformer embedding
save_model_with_config: save a pretrained model state dict to cpu and export the sentence bert config json
tokenize_text_pairs: tokenize pairs of strings as two batches for sentence similarity or pairing tasks
tokenize_dict_texts: tokenize a list of dicts mapping text keys to text values for named input handling
